context: Evaluates correct usage of detectSpacesForLevel and wallTouchesOthers from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must call detectSpacesForLevel with a levelId and WallNode array, interpret the returned Space objects and wallUpdates, and use wallTouchesOthers to check wall connectivity.

checklist.name: detectSpacesForLevel call
checklist.description: Calls detectSpacesForLevel(levelId, walls) with a valid levelId string and an array of WallNode objects, receiving the { wallUpdates, spaces } result.

checklist.name: Space object usage
checklist.description: Reads the returned Space[] array, accessing space.id, space.levelId, space.polygon, and space.isExterior fields correctly.

checklist.name: wallUpdates usage
checklist.description: Reads the returned wallUpdates array to access per-wall frontSide and backSide values ('interior' | 'exterior' | 'unknown') for each wallId.

checklist.name: wallTouchesOthers usage
checklist.description: Calls wallTouchesOthers(wall, otherWalls) with a WallNode and an array of other WallNodes to check for endpoint/segment proximity.
